title: Results and course records — GPT100 official page
publisher: SingleTrack Events / Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler
claims: The results page links 2026 timing and tracking to gpt.livingitlive.com.au and lists 2025, 2024 and 2023 results for the Miler, the 50K and the Stage Race.
Under the heading Course Records / GPT100 Miler the page lists Man Yee Cheung (HK) 27:58:45 and Caleb Olson (USA) 21:19:39, without a gender column.
The GPT50K course records are Fuzhao Xiang (CHN) 5:05:59 and Peter Frano (SVK) 4:29:20; the GPT100 Stage Race records are Nadya Fedorova (AUS) 23:44:17 and Dan Jones (NZ) 16:34:29.
The all-time finishers honour board lists six three-time Miler finishers: Greg Kew, Simon Wildes, Jarrod Burke, Justin Dyer, Luke Cooper and Marc Sutherland.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接抓取 gpt100.com.au/results，读取成绩链接、Course Records 与 Honour Board。
